# Rotapot

> Rotapot is an AI treasurer for rotating savings circles (stokvels, mukando, chama, ROSCAs). It tracks contributions, sends reminders, and prepares payouts. Only the human treasurer releases money.

## MCP endpoint

- URL: /api/mcp (Streamable HTTP, stateless, JSON responses, POST only)
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer rtp_...` (agent key created by the treasurer under "Connect an agent" on the circles home). Each key is scoped to that treasurer's account.
- Methods: initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call

## Tools

- list_circles: one line per circle (cycle, due date, who still owes, days late, recipient, payout status). Start here.
- get_circle: full detail for one circle's current cycle, including every member's status.
- verify_payment: check a member's contribution against PayPal; captures an approved checkout that was never captured.
- send_reminder: send a payment reminder to a member in their language, within the circle's rules.
- propose_payout: put the cycle's payout in front of the treasurer. Refuses unless everyone has paid. Moves no money.
- get_member_passport: a member's trust passport (payment record across circles).
- reply_to_member: send a message to one member, answering what they wrote.
- propose_payment_plan: propose up to 3 instalments within 21 days, for the treasurer to approve.
- check_payout_status: check a payout with PayPal Payouts.

## Guardrail

There is deliberately no tool that releases money or approves a plan. Agents can propose; only the treasurer releases payouts and approves plans, in the app.
